title: Hypnosis: The power of mind control
tagline: Illusion spells that hypnotize NPCs and let you rewrite who they are
description:
Hypnosis adds hypnosis spells to the Illusion school. Your SkyrimNet model plays the hypnotized NPC, so every reaction is its own.

## What it does

- **Timed hypnosis.** Murmur, Whisper and Trance put an NPC in a trance for an hour, a few hours or a day. Enthrall holds until you lift it.
- **Imprint.** The master spell opens a paused window where you rewrite a named NPC. You edit the biography and the memories, and you set how they feel about you. The old self is kept in an item.
- **Confabula and Amnesia.** One plants a false memory. The other takes chosen memories away.
- **Awakening.** Ends a trance and undoes the memory spells. With the Personality Imprint in your pack it brings the old personality back.

When a spell ends the NPC remembers everything and thinks it was their own idea. People who see you cast keep it as an event in their own history. The target is told nothing.

## Requirements

- SkyrimNet Beta 25 or Beta 26
- SKSE64 and Address Library
- PapyrusUtil SE 4.3+
- SkyUI and MCM Helper
- PrismaUI for the rewrite window

SeverActions and OStimNet are optional.

Built and tested on Skyrim 1.6.1170. Version 1.1.0 is also built for 1.7.99 and 1.7.104. I have no 1.7 install, so reports from there are welcome.

## Settings

The model settings are on this plugin's page in the dashboard. There you pick the model for drafts and set the wording of each hypnotic state. Gameplay values such as Whisper's duration are in the MCM.

English and Russian are included.
author: felixshuic
changelog:
**What's new:**

- A **Diary page** in the Imprint window. You can change what the character wrote, delete an entry or write a new one. Confabula can also change one diary entry. Awakening puts the diary back as it was.
- Two new buttons on the **Memories** page ask the model for help. **"Pick with the model"** switches off the memories that no longer fit the new personality, or the ones you describe in your own words. Amnesia can use it too, within its limit. **"Invent with the model"** turns a few words about what happened into a full memory, written by the same rules SkyrimNet uses for its own memories.
- You can now set how a rewritten character **feels about other people**. The Attitudes page has a switch that lists everyone the character has memories with.
- **Hypnotized NPCs look the other way.** While the hypnosis holds they don't report crimes to the guards and stay calm when you steal or fight in front of them. Even a failed pickpocket doesn't make them attack you. A switch in the MCM turns this off if you prefer the old way. Once it ends they react like before.
- The mod keeps its **log from the last five game starts**, so a bug report after a restart still has the run that went wrong.

**What's changed:**

- **SkyrimNet Beta 27** is supported. Beta 25 and 26 still work. The diary page needs Beta 26 or newer.
- **SeverActions 4.3.0** is supported. With 4.3.0 the patch needs the "NPC Familiarity & Reputation" option of the SeverActions installer.
